command: ETLANTIC_CP_TEST_URL=<ephemeral PostgreSQL+psycopg URL> uv run pytest -q tests/prefect/test_managed_prefect_0_58.py::test_process_worker_executes_targeted_csv_and_postgresql_transfers
result: Workspace-source live Process-worker test passed: 1 passed in 7.02s.
assertions: A real Prefect Process worker read one immutable CSV source batch and paused before releasing it to the transformation pipeline, with the canonical attempt durably running.
The authorized cancellation request was durably recorded while the worker was paused; the worker's managed cancellation event was observed before source staging was released.
After release, the accepted submission and attempt finished as cancelled, the durable run report was cancelled, and the canonical execution effect was classified as none.
The PostgreSQL sink and effect-ledger tables were empty both before and after staging resumed; cancellation did not start a sink effect.

A completed canonical ETL run was then forced to a real Prefect Failed state. Authorized status reported the remote failure and a conflict while the durable submission, attempt, successful report, and committed effect stayed completed.

limitations: This workspace-source test establishes cancellation during pre-effect source staging on a local Process pool; it is partial evidence and does not qualify the final installed-wheel compatibility matrix.
The live remote-disagreement scenario covers one completed-to-remote-failed case; broader outage and caller/worker authority-rotation combinations remain open.
Report-store and durable-artifact publication interruption remains outside this cancellation barrier and is still open.
